newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank leaves interest rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank leaves interest rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday its council left the German discount and Lombard rates unchanged after its regular policy-making meeting.

The German discount rate remains at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.50 percent. The central bank's main money market rate, the repo, was also held steady at 3.0 percent for the next two weeks.

The main agenda for the meeting on Thursday was for its semi-annual review of its money supply policy goal. No comment on this was made in the rates statement. Analysts had not expected any change either in the target or in interest rates.
